svg.title: Measured tri-mode decision boundaries
svg.desc: An empirical phase map of the selected routing mode over task budget and incumbent capability, the per-mode utility curves whose crossings create that boundary, and the factors that shift it.

svg.text: Both maps come from the reference router; the incumbent’s declared skills are scaled by the vertical factor. A mode boundary is a crossing of utilities under shared constraints, not a separate branch of rules.
